query: UPDATE projects SET analytics_revision=analytics_revision+1,analytics_settings=analytics_settings || $2::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('slo_classes',coalesce(analytics_settings->'slo_classes','{}'::jsonb)||coalesce($2::jsonb->'slo_classes','{}'::jsonb),'slo_targets',coalesce(analytics_settings->'slo_targets','{}'::jsonb)||coalesce($2::jsonb->'slo_targets','{}'::jsonb),'digest',coalesce(analytics_settings->'digest','{}'::jsonb)||coalesce($2::jsonb->'digest','{}'::jsonb)) WHERE id=$1 RETURNING analytics_settings AS settings
